questions.question_english: Which of the following defines an extrinsic reward?
options_english: A psychological reward that is derived internally from deep personal growth and self-reflection
A reward provided by the organization for specific achievements or behaviors
A continuous feeling of satisfaction after successfully mentoring a struggling high school student
The natural, inherent joy derived directly from engaging in the daily teaching-learning process
questions.explanation_english: An extrinsic reward is a tangible or intangible incentive controlled and administered by an external agent or organization to acknowledge specific behaviors, efforts, or outcomes. Unlike internal psychological satisfaction, extrinsic rewards originate outside the individual and include mechanisms such as financial compensation, formal commendations, professional promotions, public awards, and additional administrative benefits granted by management.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। एक बाह्य पुरस्कार एक ठोस या अमूर्त प्रोत्साहन है जिसे एक बाहरी एजेंट या संगठन द्वारा नियंत्रित और प्रशासित किया जाता है ताकि विशिष्ट व्यवहारों, प्रयासों या परिणामों को मान्यता दी जा सके। आंतरिक मनोवैज्ञानिक संतोष के विपरीत, बाह्य पुरस्कार व्यक्ति के बाहर उत्पन्न होते हैं और इनमें वित्तीय मुआवजा, औपचारिक प्रशंसा, पेशेवर पदोन्नति, सार्वजनिक पुरस्कार और प्रबंधन द्वारा प्रदान किए गए अतिरिक्त प्रशासनिक लाभ शामिल होते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) A reward provided by the organization for

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: An extrinsic reward is a tangible or intangible incentive controlled and administered by an external agent or organization to acknowledge specific behaviors, efforts, or outcomes.

questions.question_english: What is a common cause-and-effect outcome of heavily relying on competitive extrinsic rewards (e.g., “Best Teacher” cash prize) in a school?
options_english: It permanently eliminates all potential interpersonal conflict among teaching staff members across departments.
It dramatically enhances intrinsic motivation across the entire teaching faculty simultaneously and permanently.
It immediately and fully satisfies all statutory compliance requirements of the Directorate of Education.
It causes short-term performance spikes but reduces collaboration and increases professional jealousy.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that it causes short-term performance spikes but reduces collaboration and increases professional jealousy. Heavily relying on competitive extrinsic rewards where employees compete for limited prizes often creates dysfunctional organizational dynamics. While such contests may generate temporary individual effort spikes, they frequently destroy collaborative staff relationships, promote information hoarding, increase interpersonal tension, and foster professional jealousy, ultimately damaging overall institutional cohesiveness and school culture over time.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। यह अल्पकालिक प्रदर्शन में वृद्धि करता है लेकिन सहयोग को कम करता है और पेशेवर जलन को बढ़ाता है। प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक बाह्य पुरस्कारों पर अत्यधिक निर्भरता, जहां कर्मचारी सीमित पुरस्कारों के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं, अक्सर अस्वस्थ संगठनात्मक गतिशीलता का निर्माण करती है। जबकि ऐसे प्रतियोगिताएं अस्थायी व्यक्तिगत प्रयास में वृद्धि उत्पन्न कर सकती हैं, वे अक्सर सहयोगी कर्मचारी संबंधों को नष्ट कर देती हैं, जानकारी को छिपाने को बढ़ावा देती हैं, अंतःव्यक्तिगत तनाव को बढ़ाती हैं, और पेशेवर जलन को बढ़ावा देती हैं, जो अंततः समय के साथ समग्र संस्थागत एकता और विद्यालय संस्कृति को नुकसान पहुंचाती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) It causes short-term performance spikes but reduces collaboration and increases professional jealousy.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Heavily relying on competitive extrinsic rewards where employees compete for limited prizes often creates dysfunctional organizational dynamics.

questions.question_english:
Why do employee recognition programs sometimes fail to motivate staff?
When perceived as inauthentic, biased, or disconnected from actual performance?
options_english: When perceived as inauthentic, biased, or disconnected from actual performance
Because recognition programs are inherently too expensive for school budgets to sustain
Because modern teachers inherently dislike being appreciated or commended publicly by peers
Because they require statutory legislative amendments to be formally implemented in schools
questions.explanation_english: Recognition programs fail to motivate staff when employees view them as inauthentic, politically biased, favoritism-driven, or disconnected from real achievement. When recognition lacks objectivity and transparency, it breeds cynicism, demotivates high performers, damages administrative trust, and undermines workplace morale, emphasizing the need for clear, fair, and consistent recognition criteria.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। कर्मचारी मान्यता कार्यक्रम तब कर्मचारियों को प्रेरित करने में विफल होते हैं जब कर्मचारी उन्हें अप्रामाणिक, पक्षपाती या वास्तविक प्रदर्शन से disconnected मानते हैं। जब मान्यता में वस्तुनिष्ठता और पारदर्शिता की कमी होती है, तो यह निराशा को जन्म देती है, उच्च प्रदर्शन करने वालों को हतोत्साहित करती है, प्रशासनिक विश्वास को नुकसान पहुंचाती है, और कार्यस्थल की नैतिकता को कमजोर करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) When perceived as inauthentic, biased, or disconnected from actual performance

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Recognition programs fail to motivate staff when employees view them as inauthentic, politically biased, favoritism-driven, or disconnected from real achievement.

Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): While group incentives improve cooperation within a specific group (e.g., the English Department), they can sometimes create dysfunctional inter-group competition (e.g., English Dept vs Math Dept).
Reason (R): If resources or rewards are scarce, groups may view other groups as rivals, leading to information hoarding and a breakdown in overall school unity.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A

questions.explanation_english: While group incentive schemes improve departmental cooperation, they can accidentally create inter-group rivalry if teams view each other as competitors for limited resources. Scarcity of rewards or recognition can lead to information hoarding and departmental friction, demonstrating why school leaders must balance group incentives with whole-school unity.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जबकि समूह प्रोत्साहन योजनाएँ विभागीय सहयोग में सुधार करती हैं, वे सीमित संसाधनों के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धियों के रूप में एक-दूसरे को देखने पर अंतःसमूह प्रतिकूलता पैदा कर सकती हैं। पुरस्कारों या मान्यता की कमी जानकारी को छिपाने और विभागीय तनाव का कारण बन सकती है, जो यह दर्शाता है कि स्कूल के नेताओं को समूह प्रोत्साहनों को समग्र विद्यालय एकता के साथ संतुलित करना चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। संगठनात्मक प्रबंधन में, मान्यता कार्यक्रम को एक संरचित या अनौपचारिक तंत्र के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है जो कर्मचारी प्रयासों, उपलब्धियों और सकारात्मक कार्यस्थल व्यवहारों को मान्यता, सराहना और मान्य करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। कर्मचारियों को मूल्यवान और सम्मानित महसूस कराकर, मान्यता कार्यक्रम भावनात्मक भलाई को बढ़ाते हैं, संस्थागत मूल्यों को मजबूत करते हैं, संगठनात्मक प्रतिबद्धता को बढ़ाते हैं, और सहयोगी और सहायक कार्य वातावरण को बढ़ावा देते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A behavioral mechanism to acknowledge employee efforts and positive behaviors, making them feel valued

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In organizational management, a recognition program is defined as a structured or informal mechanism designed to acknowledge, appreciate, and validate employee efforts, accomplishments, and positive workplace behaviors.

questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'Casual Leave – Accumulated and carried forward for retirement encashment'. Casual leave is intended for short-term personal needs within a calendar year and cannot be accumulated or carried forward to subsequent years for retirement encashment. Unused casual leave lapses at the end of the calendar year, distinguishing it from Earned Leave, which can be accumulated and encashed upon retirement under service regulations.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Casual Leave – Accumulated and carried forward for retirement encashment

questions.question_english: Identify the correct pair linking a job characteristic to its corresponding intrinsic reward driver.
options_english: Task Variety – Receiving continuous operational feedback directly from the school inspector
Task Autonomy – Sticking strictly to a single mandatory teaching methodology on a daily basis
Skill Variety – Focusing solely on routine administrative record-keeping and attendance registers
Task Identity – Doing a piece of work from start to finish with a visible outcome
questions.explanation_english: Task identity refers to the degree to which a job requires completing a whole, identifiable piece of work from start to finish with a visible outcome. Experiencing complete task identity enables an individual to take pride in a tangible result, directly driving intrinsic satisfaction and motivation, unlike isolated, fragmented administrative duties or constrained routine tasks.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। कार्य पहचान उस डिग्री को संदर्भित करता है जिसमें एक नौकरी को शुरू से अंत तक एक संपूर्ण, पहचानने योग्य काम को पूरा करने की आवश्यकता होती है, जिसमें एक स्पष्ट परिणाम होता है। पूर्ण कार्य पहचान का अनुभव करने से एक व्यक्ति को एक ठोस परिणाम पर गर्व करने की अनुमति मिलती है, जो अंतर्निहित संतोष और प्रेरणा को सीधे बढ़ाता है, जबकि अलग-थलग, खंडित प्रशासनिक कार्यों या सीमित नियमित कार्यों की तुलना में।

questions.question_english: How is an intrinsic reward best defined in the context of pedagogical practice?
options_english: An internal psychological payoff a teacher gains directly from performing a task well
A tangible incentive provided by the school management committee for extraordinary duties
A statutory allowance granted for acquiring higher educational qualifications during service
A competitive monetary award given annually by the Directorate of Education to top teachers
questions.explanation_english: An intrinsic reward represents an internal psychological payoff that an individual experiences directly from engaging in and completing a task successfully. Unlike external tangible incentives, intrinsic rewards stem from deep internal feelings of competence, personal growth, autonomy, self-efficacy, and meaningful accomplishment inherent in the execution of pedagogical practices and professional responsibilities within educational environments.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अंतर्निहित पुरस्कार एक आंतरिक मनोवैज्ञानिक लाभ का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो एक व्यक्ति कार्य में संलग्न होने और उसे सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करने से सीधे अनुभव करता है। बाहरी ठोस प्रोत्साहनों के विपरीत, अंतर्निहित पुरस्कार आत्म-क्षमता, व्यक्तिगत विकास, स्वायत्तता, और शैक्षणिक प्रथाओं और पेशेवर जिम्मेदारियों के कार्यान्वयन में निहित अर्थपूर्ण उपलब्धियों के गहरे आंतरिक भावनाओं से उत्पन्न होते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) An internal psychological payoff a teacher gains directly from performing a task well

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: An intrinsic reward represents an internal psychological payoff that an individual experiences directly from engaging in and completing a task successfully.

questions.question_english: Which of the following represents an exception to the concept of a monetary reward?
options_english: Mandatory annual increment based on satisfactory APAR grading
Special cash prize awarded for achieving 100% board results
Title of 'Senior Coordinator' without extra pay
Direct paid performance bonus credited directly to bank account
questions.explanation_english: Bestowing a symbolic professional title like Senior Coordinator without any accompanying financial stipend or salary increase constitutes a non-monetary recognition mechanism. Conversely, cash prizes, salary increments, and direct performance bonuses involve direct monetary disbursements. Non-monetary structural designations enhance professional standing and leadership authority without altering baseline financial compensation structures or generating institutional costs.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। बिना किसी वित्तीय भत्ते या वेतन वृद्धि के 'वरिष्ठ समन्वयक' का प्रतीकात्मक पेशेवर शीर्षक देना एक गैर-मौद्रिक मान्यता तंत्र का गठन करता है। इसके विपरीत, नकद पुरस्कार, वेतन वृद्धि और प्रत्यक्ष प्रदर्शन बोनस सीधे मौद्रिक भुगतान में शामिल होते हैं। गैर-मौद्रिक संरचनात्मक पदनाम पेशेवर स्थिति और नेतृत्व प्राधिकरण को बढ़ाते हैं बिना मौलिक वित्तीय मुआवजे की संरचनाओं को बदले या संस्थागत लागत उत्पन्न किए।

questions.question_english: Identify the incorrect pairing concerning reward types.
options_english: Cash Bonus – Monetary Reward
Preferred parking spot – Non-monetary Reward
Advance Increment – Monetary Reward
Public Praise – Intrinsic Reward
questions.explanation_english: Public praise delivered by a supervisor constitutes an extrinsic non-monetary reward because it is an external social recognition mechanism. Intrinsic rewards, by definition, are internally generated psychological feelings of personal accomplishment and purpose. Therefore, pairing public praise with intrinsic rewards is conceptually incorrect, as public recognition is administered externally rather than experienced purely internally.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। सार्वजनिक प्रशंसा, जो एक पर्यवेक्षक द्वारा दी जाती है, एक बाह्य गैर-मौद्रिक इनाम है क्योंकि यह एक बाहरी सामाजिक मान्यता तंत्र है। आंतरिक पुरस्कार, परिभाषा के अनुसार, व्यक्तिगत उपलब्धि और उद्देश्य की आंतरिक रूप से उत्पन्न मनोवैज्ञानिक भावनाएँ होती हैं। इसलिए, सार्वजनिक प्रशंसा को आंतरिक पुरस्कारों के साथ जोड़ना वैचारिक रूप से गलत है, क्योंकि सार्वजनिक मान्यता बाहरी रूप से प्रशासित होती है न कि केवल आंतरिक रूप से अनुभव की जाती है।
